verdict.rationale: Browserbase publishes a versioned OpenAPI document (openapi.v1, version v1), and its endpoints are served under a /v1 path, so the versioning half of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack shows a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or changelog commitments. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset notice process, evidence of how version transitions are handled, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
